title: Marine litter abundance and composition in Arraial do Cabo, Brazil
description: A reproducible research compendium containing the official workbook, standardized transect-level data, analysis scripts, publication-ready tables and figures, and statistical reports for marine-litter observations from Praia Brava and Ilha do Pontal, Arraial do Cabo, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.
notes: Version 1.1.0 corrects the official workbook after a cell-by-cell check against the original field tally sheets: (1) the campaign labels of Ilha do Pontal had been reversed (field order winter, autumn, spring, summer read as summer, spring, autumn, winter); (2) 29 metal fragments recorded at Praia Brava had been omitted and are now included (2,950 items in total); (3) the column previously named "fragments" is the rubber-fragment class of the field sheet and is now named rubber_fragments. All tables, figures and statistics were regenerated. The superseded workbook is kept in data/raw/superseded/. See docs/analysis_decisions.md (AD-007). Version 1.1.1 has the same data and results as 1.1.0; it removes two files that had been included in the 1.1.0 archive by mistake (a manuscript-review document and the script that generated it).
